description: 2026-05-23 follow-up regression guard. Two Normal-mode clips meeting at a section break with fadeSeconds > 0. Before this fix, Fix 8's extension fired for clip 1 (Normal + end-aligns-with-break + sourceTimelineFrames > duration), keeping its decoder running indefinitely past the break. With clip 2 also decoding from the same break, two 4K H.264 working sets blew the FrameCache budget and triggered Fix 4's cache-miss recovery in a thrash loop, freezing clip 2's video while audio kept advancing. The fix gates Fix 8's extension on fadeSeconds == 0 at the ending break: when the operator sets a non-zero fade, the clip ends per the existing tail-frames mechanism (fades out, decoder stops), no extension, no cache thrash. Setup: tone_1khz.mov on tracks 0 and 1, both duration=30 ending/starting at break 30 with fadeSeconds=1.0 (30 frames tail). After GO, the playhead must cleanly advance through and past the fade window. The fixture's 150-frame source range is what would have triggered Fix 8 extension pre-fix (sourceTimelineFrames=150 > duration=30). Asserts playhead at frame 90 (60 frames after GO at break+1=31, ~2s of real-time playback) with tolerance.
